cases.title: Add new bookmark
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be added successfully.

cases.title: Add bookmark to specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark from File
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file.

cases.title: Remove Deleted Bookmark Display from All Access Points
cases.description: Verify that a deleted bookmark is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add bookmark to personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully added to the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert New Bookmark Folder Into Hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder is successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Launch Bookmark in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks packaged with browser are valid links
cases.description: Verify that all bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser contain valid links.

cases.title: Verify bookmark item changes are saved without item integrity loss
cases.description: Modify a bookmark item and verify that the changes are successfully saved while maintaining full item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add Bookmarks Separators
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators are successfully added.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Separators
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators are successfully deleted.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes persistence over browser restart
cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes are successfully saved and maintained after restarting the browser.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes persistence over browser crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes are successfully saved and maintained following a browser crash event.

cases.title: Verify negative execution of view properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties do not successfully execute or are prevented for bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Rename bookmark inline without properties dialog
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed directly 'inline' without having to open the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be found by using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly showed to display additional entry details.

cases.title: Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden from view.

cases.title: Delete Several Bookmarks Simultaneously
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted at one time.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child within the bookmarks hierarchy.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their explicit behaviors have been fully and properly mapped to the proposed test cases with no missing scenarios or confirmed blockers.
